name: Meshillemoth
title: Ephraimite Leader
summary: Meshillemoth was the father of Berechiah, one of the leaders in the tribe of Ephraim who supported the prophet Oded's call to return the Judean captives that Israel had taken in war. He is mentioned in 2 Chronicles as an influential figure among the heads of Ephraim during the reign of King Pekah.

keyEvents.title: The War Between Israel and Judah
keyEvents.description: During the time of King Pekah of Israel and King Ahaz of Judah, Israel waged war against Judah and took many captives. The prophet Oded spoke out against making their brothers into slaves.

keyEvents.title: The Prophet Oded's Exhortation
keyEvents.description: The prophet Oded met the Israelite army and warned them that the Lord's wrath rested upon them if they kept the captives from Judah.

keyEvents.title: Ephraim's Leaders Intervene
keyEvents.description: Meshillemoth's son Berechiah and other leaders in Ephraim rose up against the warriors and demanded that the captives be released, in line with the prophet Oded's words.

keyEvents.title: The Captives Are Sent Back
keyEvents.description: The named leaders, including Berechiah son of Meshillemoth, made sure that the captives were clothed, given food and drink, and sent back to Jericho in Judah.
